method: Two independent read-only reviews of enumerated inputs; no subdelegation; baseline input hashes verified unchanged after both reports. Root concurrently prepared new scripts and disposable build candidates only.
decision: Proceed with local routing and pinned ZMK, preserving topology, poses and outline. No physical/fabrication acceptance.

findings.finding: Default nice_view_adapter conflicts with matrix GPIO
findings.disposition: Use explicit nice_view_spi at P0.08/P0.06/P1.11 ACTIVE_HIGH and verify compiled DTS.

findings.finding: Parity and passive ERC do not prove every physical pad or connectivity
findings.disposition: Check each physical pad against final netlist plus semantic matrix and zero DRC disconnects.

findings.finding: RF/display sleep and connector/cell limits unqualified
findings.disposition: Keep physical qualification pending; no charging boost; verify polarity and actual cell charge limits before energization.

findings.finding: Switch disconnects cell and charging but USB can still power MCU
Right visual matrix differs from electrical column sequence
findings.disposition: Check all 36 entries against source layout and compiled transform.

version_choice: Reuse official stable ZMK v0.3.0 edf5c0814fd3ea202e43aad2d68fd32e882a518c and existing verified toolchain; target nice_nano_v2 is tied to this version, not current main.
